# BillionVerify

> Validate email addresses in real-time or clean millions of records with the BillionVerify API, SDK docs, developer guides and market benchmark.

- Type: API and SDK documentation, developer guides and a market benchmark for BillionVerify, an email verification service
- Publisher: BillionVerify (https://billionverify.com/), an email verification service
- Free checks: the BillionVerify Email Checker and Email Verifier on billionverify.com each check one address with a live SMTP check, 20 times per IP every 24 hours, with no sign-up
- Last updated: 2026-11-21

Every page has a Markdown version: add .md to the path without the trailing slash. The home page is /index.md.

This site is in English only.

- [Docs](https://billionverify.github.io/docs/): API reference, SDKs and AI integrations
- [Guides](https://billionverify.github.io/guides/): temp mail, disposable email detection and verification in code
- [Benchmark](https://billionverify.github.io/benchmark/): 19 email verification services compared
